The refresher is a one-day activity with pool practice and one ocean dive. The Referral Course includes four certification dives over two days. Both prices include the 10% online discount; the exact total for two people will be shown in the booking flow.

One important detail: the refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years, and it *doesn’t count toward the Open Water course*. The refresher has a 12-hour no-fly wait afterward, so please check the timing before planning the course days.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊
